FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Pawsitive Care Veterinary Services specializes in providing routine veterinary care, diagnostics, and minor surgical procedures primarily for companion animals. Our operations are rooted in a commitment to animal welfare, ensuring that all animal containment areas comply with local welfare standards. Our highly trained team, composed exclusively of licensed veterinarians and credentialed veterinary technicians, performs all medical procedures to minimize malpractice risk. We prioritize the health and safety of both our animal patients and staff by maintaining a clean, secure facility free from unsanitary conditions and pest infestations. Additionally, we have established sound waste handling protocols, including compliant biohazard and sharps disposal practices. We do not engage in large-scale boarding operations, ensuring that our primary focus remains on delivering high-quality veterinary care. Regular maintenance and calibration of our diagnostic and surgical equipment further support our commitment to excellent care and compliance with health regulations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not have any history of veterinary licensing violations or unresolved regulatory actions and confirms that there have been no major malpractice, animal injury, or property damage claims in the past five years. Additionally, any boarding services offered are limited and ancillary, in full compliance with the requirement that large-scale operations are not permitted. All animal containment areas meet or exceed local animal welfare standards, ensuring the highest level of care for the animals.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a dog under our care sustained an injury during a routine examination, resulting in a veterinary claim of $2,000. The claim was resolved with no further complications, and we have since implemented additional safety measures to prevent future incidents. Status: Resolved.
